correctness.rationale: The full result was checked at the level of quantifiers and generators: the elementary inclusion-matrix rank induction gives exact full row ranks, inclusion–exclusion gives Kneser and Johnson boundary rowspace equality, explicit adjacency identities make their common kernel invariant, dissipativity rules out any additional loss-free eigenvector, symmetry and a recurrence give every projector entry, and a 10-by-10 strictly positive Gram matrix identifies the distance-two complement-antisymmetric kernel. The included verifier checks 14 small parameter cases and the complete 7-point middle-shell matrix over exact rationals. Finite experiments are supplemental and do not substitute for the general proof; only the stated non-Hermitian model is addressed.

value.rationale: This is an exact physical invariant for every initial density matrix of two natural inequivalent Johnson-scheme hopping networks at every size with arbitrary strictly positive detector rates. The distinguished-boundary projector, Catalan dark-space rank, and smallest intermediate-shell double-rank resonance offer an informative structural comparison; a complementary pair changes from one-half absorption to perfectly dark by changing only hopping range. This is neither a routine graph invariant without interpretation nor an arbitrary parameter slice; the n=7,k=3 graph is the first natural nontrivial middle-distance Johnson relation and yields a concrete phase-sensitive boundary to universality.
